michaela: Heads-up — PR #14321 needs to land before tomorrow's deploy freeze (15:00 UTC). It's blocked by two flaky integration jobs in staging. Can someone give quick eyes? :eyes:
leo: Which jobs are failing?
michaela: `integration.staging.stream_timeout` and `integration.staging.kv_persistence`. The stream one times out on the Windows matrix at the 120s mark. Snippet from logs:
```
TimeoutError: waited 120s for response
  at StreamHandler.handle (stream_handler.go:212)
  at test_integration.go:58
```
raj: I can look. Do we have a rebase slot today? I don't want to rebase and then block during freeze.
release-ops: We have a 10-min rebase slot at 13:55 UTC (small PRs only). Canary is scheduled for 16:00 UTC. If you need a 14:00 slot, it's currently free but reserved for infra patches.
leo: Could we rerun just the two failing jobs instead of the whole matrix?
ci-bot: @leo rerun requested for jobs [789012, 789013] by leo. Jobs queued — position 3.
anya: I'll hold on approving until CI is green. Please add a brief mitigation/rollback note to the PR so reviewers know the plan.
michaela: Done: PR description updated with "workaround: reduce batch_size for streaming handler in Windows; rollback path: revert handler and pin runtime to v2 for affected routes."
ci-bot: Job 789012 finished — stream_timeout still failing. Job 789013 (kv_persistence) queued.
sam (oncall): FYI, rerunning the full matrix during ramp into freeze is risky. Recommend targeted reruns + canary rather than full matrix. If we can't get green before freeze, hold merge and use tomorrow morning slot. :thumbsup:
raj: I'll rebase locally, run the two failing tests in a container, push a fix if repros, then trigger targeted jobs. ETA ~35m.
michaela: Thanks — we'll hold merge for now. Marking PR as `waiting-on-ci`.
leo: If this misses today's window, target tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Release-ops, can you reserve a small morning slot?
release-ops: Noted. I'll tentatively reserve 09:10 UTC tomorrow for a quick landing slot if needed.
ci-bot: Friendly reminder: please do not use `[ci skip]` for test-bearing PRs — that will block merges.
raj: Pushed a small timeout tweak and repro script to my branch, triggered jobs 789200 and 789201 (targeted). Will ping again with results.
michaela: Copy. Standing by. :eyes:
